links.outcome: Chatbot treatment plan safety, product selection, and injection strategy ratings on Likert scales
links.effect: ChatGPTo1 and ChatGPT4o scored higher than Claude, CopilotPro, and Llama (p<0.05); ChatGPTo1 safety score 1.30 ± 0.17; total scores 7.87 and 7.85 of 10; safety limitations remain.
links.quote: However, safety limitations remain and preclude unsupervised clinical use.

screen.reason: The study retrospectively/simulation-evaluates multiple off-the-shelf generative AI models on patient photos/data for facial injection planning accuracy and safety without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment intervention.
